name: smwmusic-the-11th-vanilla-level-design-contest-mountain-2-extended
title: The 11th Vanilla Level Design Contest - Mountain 2 (Extended Version)
description:
An adventurous and somewhat heroic sounding arrangement using the SMW leitmotif. Good for those epic, tall mountain climbing levels. Originally made for the VLDC11 Music Remix Contest, it now comes in an extended and revised version, although I've also included the original version (with the revisions) if the extended part doesn't suit your taste.

If you're wondering why it's called Mountain 2, well, it's just because this is the second mountain arrangement made for a VLDC, the first one being for VLDC7 (much like how the third VLDC cave arrangement is called Cave 3, for example). So in short, it's a convention.

Samples omitted: 09 SMW @7.brr, 0D SMW @14.brr, 0F SMW @21.brr, 11 SMW @17.brr.
INCOMPATIBLE WITH: Bonus End music.
